newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Alcatel Alsthom Maroc turnover down.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel Alsthom Maroc turnover down.

text.p: Moroccan-French electrical equipment company Alcatel Alsthom Maroc showed a turnover of 391.1 million dirhams ($44.9 million) in the first half of the year, down 8.8 percent on the previous period in 1995.
A Casablanca-based subsidiary of French Alcatel Alsthom, the firm recorded a profit of 12.1 million dirhams ($1.3 million) in first half 1996, against 20.5 million dirhams in the whole year of 1995.
It gave no comparative figures for the first half last year.
The company's capital remained unchanged at 168.2 million dirhams.
One of the 46 listed stocks on the bourse Alcatel was last traded at 610 dirhams.
